build_inputblock: build an InputBlock module that wraps InputLayer with node and edge normalization for graph neural networks
create_inputlayer: create an InputLayer module that processes edge features through a linear layer, normalization, and feedforward network
run_inputblock_forward: run the InputBlock forward pass to get normalized node and edge features from GraphAttentionData inputs
review_inputlayer_forward: review the InputLayer forward method that aggregates edge outputs into node features using neighbor masks
test_inputblock_normalization: test the InputBlock normalization layers that apply configurable normalization to node and edge features
